{{Quote|Want to hear a crazy story? This guy last night in the cantina was telling us where there's this group of people running around moving things with their minds. He says there was this cave filled with crystals where all of them live.|A commoner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ac">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|a commoner|Dantooine}}</ref>}}
The '''Force Crystal Hunter's Cave''' was a cave on the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] containing a large quantity of [[force crystal]]s. The crystals were discovered in the cave during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:FCHC" /> Then, [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] crystal hunters roamed the cave in search for such force crystals.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

[[File:Force_Crystal_Hunter_Cave_2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Large crystal deposits on the walls of the cave]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer visited the cave and collected a [[White Thranta Shipping Company|White Thranta]] knuckler.<ref name="SWG:RMWMIV">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Melee Weapons Mark IV}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Force Crystal Hunter's Cave was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FCHC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
